content.title: Sting
content.text: March 20, 2026 We are delighted to announce that Sting has added second concerts in both Nashville and Pittsburgh during his North American tour this fall. The shows are at The Truth in Nashville, TN on October 20 and at Citizens Live at The Wylie in Pittsburgh, PA on November 7. Tickets go on presale to Sting.com members on Wednesday, March 25 at 10am local and on general sale on Friday, March 27... March 19, 2026 Villa d’Este announces its most anticipated summer event - Sting in concert in the Mosaic Garden on 9 August 2026. At Villa d’Este, Lake Como and its monumental gardens become a stage, where history resonates and music intertwines with beauty. It is in this timeless setting that, on 9 August 2026, world-renowed artist, Sting will offer the Grand Hotel’s guests an evening destined to become a treasured memory... March 16, 2026 We are delighted to announce that Sting has added a further concert to his North American tour this fall on the highly revered “STING 3.0” World Tour, presented by the Cherrytree Music Company and Live Nation. The show is at The Truth in Nashville, TN on October 19. Tickets go on presale to Sting.com members on Wednesday, March 18 at 10am local and on general sale on March 20 at 10am local... March 16, 2026 We are delighted to announce that Sting has added a further concert to his North American tour this fall on the highly revered “STING 3.0” World Tour, presented by the Cherrytree Music Company and Live Nation. The show is at Citizens Live at The Wylie in Pittsburgh, PA on November 6. Tickets go on presale to Sting.com members on Wednesday, March 18 at 10am local and on general sale on March 20 at 10am local... March 9, 2026 We are delighted to announce that Sting has added second concerts on the highly revered “STING 3.0” World Tour, presented by the Cherrytree Music Company and Live Nation in Minneapolis (Oct 14), Indianapolis (Oct 23) and Akron (Nov 2) and a fourth show in Montreal (Oct 30). Tickets go on presale to Sting.com members from 10am (local time) on Tuesday March 10 (Wed, Mar 11 for Montreal) with tickets going on general sale from Friday, March 13 at 10am (local time)... March 5, 2026 During his time in Amsterdam, ARTE captured Sting’s breathtaking performance at the Rijksmuseum, creating a stunning live film that will premiere on ARTE’s VOD platform on March 5 before broadcasting across the network in Germany and France on March 27. The performance will also receive a physical release on CD and vinyl, titled Sting – The Night Watch: Live at the Rijksmuseum, with pre-orders launching March 5 ahead of the June 26 release... ON THIS DAY... 2025: Sting performed at Grand Arena in Cape Town, South Africa.2022: Sting performed at SAP Arena in Mannheim, Germany. ▶2019: Sting performed at a sneak peek event at the Ahmanson Theatre in Los Angeles, USA to promote The Last Ship's LA run in early 2020.1994: Sting performed at Velez Sarfield Stadium in Buenos Aires, Argentina.1991: Sting performed at Reunion Arena in Dallas, USA. ▶1988: Sting performed at the Aladdin Hotel in Reno, USA.1982: The Police performed at Lloyd Noble Arena in Oklahoma City, USA.1980: The Police performed at Rang Bhawan stadium in Bombay, India. ▶ SUMMONER'S TALES... "Growing older develops a certain wisdom in your voice and it brings out a new man out of me. I am closer to the truth when I sing. It marks more who I am. The uniqueness comes out better. It is like a brand and people recognize my voice instantly. I don't sound like anybody else." IN THE STORE
